Optional simplification: anchor on the mountinfo prefix and constrain `/containers/...<id>` to the root field (whitespace-free token), so option-field content like `lowerdir=...` can never contribute a match. Also lets you switch `Matcher::matches` to `Matcher::find` since the regex no longer needs a trailing `/.*$`.

```suggestion
      Pattern.compile("^\\d+ \\d+ \\d+:\\d+ [^ ]*/containers/[^ ]*?([0-9a-f]{64})");
```
